'''What changed on the card image''' compared with the previous version (the high-resolution image of 6 January 2022; left = before, right = after): [[File:V12-D-admiraltrenchholo_ai-2022-12-12-vs-hires-2022-01-06-changes.png|frameless|upright=2]].
* '''Original''' ([[Admiral Trench (Holo AI)]]): PC high-resolution card image uploaded 6 January 2022<ref name="img-altpng-26f4c95-admiraltrenchholoaipng">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/hires/admiraltrenchholo_ai.png</code> (high-resolution image) in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/26f4c95070e8e65cf67c23e464b3a1b476792715 commit 26f4c95] (6 January 2022) (“Alternate Images”). The earliest published image of this card: it was only ever committed as a high-resolution PNG, so version lists built from the card-size images missed it (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
